segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ שְׁנֵי קַדָּרִין שֶׁהָיוּ מְהַלְּכִין זֶה אַחַר זֶה, וְנִתְקַל הָרִאשׁוֹן וְנָפַל, וְנִתְקַל הַשֵּׁנִי בָּרִאשׁוֹן – הָרִאשׁוֹן חַיָּיב בְּנִזְקֵי שֵׁנִי.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «two potters» carrying pots «who were walking one after the other» in the public domain, «and the first stumbled» on a bump «and fell, and the second stumbled over the first» and fell too, «the first» is «liable» to pay «for the damage incurred by the second.»

moves.summary: first potter liable for second's damage

positions.claim: the first potter who stumbled is liable for damage to the second who stumbled over him
